Evan L: Hey team — first day! HR finished but Im stuck: HubSpot shows read-only, no Gong access, and Dialpad keeps failing when I try to claim an extension. Also can't find the AE quick-start deck. Who do I ping?
Marta (Sales Ops): Welcome Evan! Tagging myself. Can you confirm the exact work email you used for onboarding?
Evan L: evan.l@redwood.ai. Thanks.
Marta (Sales Ops): Copy. Submitting a provisioning request. Short form Im sending to IT:```Name: Evan L
Email: evan.l@redwood.ai
Manager: Diego (AE Mgr)
Role: Account Exec
Seats: HubSpot - Sales Rep, Gong, Dialpad ext
Notes: needs AE quickstart deck and sandbox access```
Evan L: Nice, appreciate it. Any ETA?
CallBot: Provisioning ticket created by Marta (Sales Ops). Ticket RB-20260324-12. ETA 20-60 mins.
Diego (Sales Enablement): Evan  welcome! AE quick-start is in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.internal/sales/ae-quickstart. Ill also share the deck and the 1-week playbook in #sales-resources.
Ben (CS): Evan, once you have Gong, ping me and Ill walk you through the CS handoff snippet and the pre-call checklist. Quick FYI: enable "auto-transcription" + set highlights to public for mentor review.
Marta (Sales Ops): Update: HubSpot permissions escalated to full Sales Rep. Invite should be accepted. Gong invite resent (check spam). Dialpad queued; extension should be assigned within 30 mins. Sandbox account created: sandbox-evan@redwood-sandbox.io (link emailed).
Evan L: Got HubSpot access and the sandbox email. Dialpad still shows "pending".
Marta (Sales Ops): Dialpad provisioning completed: ext 1207 assigned. You should see a welcome SMS. If not, LMK and Ill ping Dialpad support.
Evan L: SMS arrived, set up MFA and tested outbound — works. Who can I shadow for first week calls?
Diego (Sales Enablement): Ill schedule shadow sessions with two top AEs this week. Also sending the "First 10 Calls" cheat sheet.
Evan L: Thanks! One more - where do we store Gong highlight templates and email snippets?
Diego (Sales Enablement): Gong templates + snippets are in Drive -> Sales -> Templates. I dropped two templates in your Drive: "Intro Call - AE" and "Discovery - AE". Also snippets are in HubSpot: Snippets > AE Templates.
Ben (CS): I added you to the shared Gong folder and set you as a reviewer on my highlights so you can see examples.
Evan L: All good. Thanks everyone, excited to get started :rocket:
Marta (Sales Ops): Closing RB-20260324-12. Reopen if anything else pops up.
